findings.reason: the plan must name this inventory and say which rows retire on resolution, or its own measure (non-zero coverage) is satisfied while the property audit fails.
findings.text: the plan's "each of the three gets an owner" ignores that all three are already recorded in the `_ADJUDICATED_OCCURRENCES` inventory (related_ids at line 99 and embed_failed_at at line 105 under [runtime], patterns_found's predecessor patterns_detected under [defect]), and the audit fails closed on a "stale <category> adjudication" once the source occurrence changes, so resolving an owner without editing these rows leaves the detector red

findings.reason: choosing CodeChunk as the owner leaves the same undeclared write live on every other embedding-bearing label and the plan's "the property it stopped querying must be gone" measure never inspects it.
findings.text: the plan treats embed_failed_at as one property with one owner on CodeChunk, but `_mark_embed_failed(label, ids)` interpolates the label and writes it on every text-embeddable label, and only StandardName declares it (imas_codex/schemas/standard_name.yaml:1028), so the real owner is the per-class embedding slot family (imas_codex/schemas/facility.yaml:851, 1660, 1866, 2278, 2826, 3194, 3263, 3763, 3928 with no shared mixin) rather than one label

findings.reason: the correct owner (a shared embedding mixin, or a rename) follows from the declaration the plan did not cite, so its "declare nothing / declare the runtime property" fork is the wrong choice set.
findings.text: §1 asserts embed_failed_at is "nothing — an operational marker with no declaration", but imas_codex/schemas/standard_name.yaml:1028 declares the same slot on StandardName, and imas_codex/standard_name/graph_ops.py:18414 writes it there, so the disagreement is a duplicate across labels, not an absence, and the plan searched neither schema it depends on

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — no module is proposed; the plan is a three-property ownership decision with no new interface, so there is nothing whose depth could be shallow.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan proposes to "settle ownership" of three properties without naming the owner to extend, and re-adjudicates rather than editing the existing ownership record at imas_codex/graph/cypher_property_check.py:57-195.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; no section adds a definition, option, view or refusal family, so nothing needs to be named as retired.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan names no existing mechanism by file (not the audit module imas_codex/graph/cypher_property_check.py, not the schema that already declares two of the three properties, not the migration convention in imas_codex/graph/AGENTS.md), and its §1 premise that embed_failed_at has "no declaration" is contradicted by the schema it did not cite.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — no wrapper is proposed over existing machinery; the plan proposes to settle ownership and change the write/query paths in place.
